patch.value: GH-911: preserve runtime dependency resolution in post-install activation probes

GitHub #911 reports that the isolated temporary module-graph copy severs npm-hoisted runtime dependencies, falsely returning ok:false for working extensions and leaking temporary copies. Probe the installed runtime topology or reproduce its dependency closure, and clean every temporary graph.

A local npm package with a hoisted declared runtime dependency installs with truthful activation status; real load failures still fail; temporary graph directories are always removed; packed npm/local/cross-platform tests pass.
